systems.name: Quality Management System
real: ISO-9001-aligned quality gates: coverage against DECLARED sections, plus a zero-stub screen
persistent traceable defects + the §8.7/§10.2 correct→re-verify loop (W307)
owns document control (ISO 9001 §7.5) — quality records placed under DCMS control
limits: a delivery that declares NO required sections has no coverage to measure: the gate returns not-assessable and a defect opened that way cannot be re-verified from content (W497) — only a caller-attested figure closes it, recorded as that

summary.closed_basis: 'closed' counts defects re-verified and passed. A defect closed because its source was retired, or reported not reproducible, was not re-verified: each is counted apart and moves nothing in the rate
summary.dispositions_basis: 0 defect(s) closed because the surface that opened them was retired and 0 reported not reproducible, each with the reason, name and time its person gave; neither is a re-verification, so neither is counted as closed above, as a gate pass or in the rate. Open now under a label no live surface opens a defect under: 0
summary.attested_basis: No caller-attested re-verification has been counted: the counter starts at the first one after it was added, and any run before that is in the rate and not in this count. 0 defect(s) closed now were last re-verified on typed figures. By ruling (OWNER 2026-10-11) attested re-verifications STAY in the rate: these counts stand beside it and change it by nothing.
summary.rate_basis: gate failures / gates run across ALL deliveries on this platform (every entity and tenant share one QMS store) — not one entity's record. What-if gates run on typed metrics, and re-verifications of the defects they open, are counted separately and excluded. A re-verification of a DELIVERY defect does count, including one attested by its caller (W316: a correction that does not hold must raise the rate).
